data.name: Nudar
data.gender_notes: Nudar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nudar is an Arabic name that means 'rare' or 'unique'. It is a name that reflects the individuality and distinctiveness of its bearer. The name Nudar carries the meaning “Rare, Unique” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nudar usually hope their child will grow to embody rare, unique and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nudar is associated with the concept of tawhid, or the oneness of God, emphasizing the uniqueness and singularity of Allah.
data.etymology: Nudar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rare, Unique.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nudar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: نضر
in_arabic.meaning: يعني الظهور و الظهور بقوة و وضوح
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نضر مشتق من الجذر النضري و يعني الظهور و الظهور بقوة و وضوح، و في بعض الأحيان يرتبط بمعنى النور و الإشراق. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يظهر بقوة و وضوح في المجتمع.

in_urdu.name: نضر
in_urdu.meaning: ظاہر ہونے کا مطلب ہے، طاقت و وضاحت کے ساتھ ظاہر ہونا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام نضر عربی جڑ نضری سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے ظاہر ہونے کا، خاص طور پر طاقت و وضاحت کے ساتھ۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے آپ کو واضح اور مضبوط طریقے سے ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

Etymologically linked to notions of light and radiance, Nudar connotes positive attributes such as enlightenment and guidance.
